mina: Quick heads-up: scheduling a midnight maintenance for us-west2 on Fri 02:45-03:45 UTC. Purpose: rolling node reboots + NIC microcode patch across GPU racks to fix sporadic egress packet drops. Cohorts: 3 racks / cohort, 8m cooldown. Please ack.

tom: ack. i'll ensure we keep >=70% GPU capacity. will pause low-priority batches and use spot backfill.

sai: can we pre-seed KV cache 20m prior? also prepare routing fallback to eu-west for tolerant workloads.

mina: yes to both. ops-bot: set incident open if available_gpu < 60% for 5m OR p95_latency > 220ms for 4m.

ops-bot: alerts configured. Will notify #oncall if triggered.

tom: runbook short checklist: pre-seed, cordon+drain (grace 300s), nic-flash, reboot, uncordon, kv-verify. I'll be on shift 02:30-04:00 UTC.

sai: notif-bot: please schedule customer banner 60m and 15m before window.

mina: final note: staging dry-run tomorrow 10:00 UTC to validate nic-flash. report results here.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled.

mina: thanks team, closing thread.
